svg.aria-label: Install cabinets, shelves and the refrigerator (printed page 27)
svg.text: Pantry R35 — sanitized source excerpt
Install cabinets, shelves and the refrigerator (printed page 27)
Text-only card: no address, parcel or permit identity and no raw source links. Quotations keep the printed wording.
printed page 27
HOLD: actual cabinet rail templates, fasteners and full load path
printed page 27
B1 is the 12-in drawer-over-door base immediately beside the refrigerator. B2/B3 are larger white drawer
bases.
printed page 27
01. Dry-fit all three base boxes on their supported floor locations: B1, F1, B2, F2, B3, starting at the
fridge separator. Check total 106½-in box width plus two ¾-in fillers and the actual
toe-kick/counter/side scribe.
03. Set the butcher-block counter at the intended 36-in top elevation only after base heights and top
thickness are measured. Confirm the planned 26-in clear distance to U1/U2 bottoms at 62 in.
04. Mount U1/U2 36×34 and U3 over-fridge 36×24 using their actual rails/holes into approved W1 wood and
connectors. Place three 36-in butcher-block shelves on selected visible heavy-duty brackets fixed into
full studs.
05. Set the GE GSE25GYPHCFS in its 37-in clear bay with manufacturer-required clearances. Test door
swing, bin removal, walking access and service removal before final panel or filler fastening.
printed page 27
Upper cabinet and shelf loads cannot be certified by a backing diagram alone. The block-to-stud joint,
W1 top/base/end restraints and cabinet/shelf screw instructions must form one accepted load path.
Source family: r35-p27-fixtures.svg · printed page 27 of the R35 conditional plan (29 pages).
